title: Parallel read_csv quoted-newline chunk error fallback
answers: Why does pd.read_csv raise ValueError on CSV files with quoted newlines when multithreading?
How are chunk parsing errors handled during parallel CSV reading in read_csv?
Why does parallel read_csv fall back to serial reading on worker exceptions?
read_csv fails with ValueError on multiline quoted fields in parallel mode
body:
Symptom: pd.read_csv() raises ValueError or converter errors on valid CSV files with quoted newlines when reading in parallel, or reports non-deterministic error positions on invalid files.
Root cause: pandas/io/parsers/readers.py:_read_csv_chunks worker threads did not catch reader._engine.read() exceptions, allowing misaligned chunks after quoted-newline split boundaries to raise conversion errors before serial fallback could occur.
Fix pattern: Catch chunk read exceptions in worker threads, halt remaining workers via a shared threading.Event, and return None from pandas/io/parsers/readers.py:_read_csv_chunks to trigger serial fallback.
Constraints: Applies to parallel chunk parsing where split boundaries can misalign tokens or produce out-of-order errors; does not apply to non-chunk errors in pandas/io/parsers/readers.py:_read or post-chunk concatenation, which signal bugs and must propagate.
applies: pandas.read_csv parallel chunk parsing with C engine across multiple worker threads
